title: Equality case of the proper compact-support compositor
statement: For proper p and f, properRouteCompIso A p f (p;f) rfl equals rightDerivedLowerShriekCompIso A p f.

proof.text: Unfold properRouteCompIso and the equality congruence isomorphism; the latter is the identity, so the remaining transitive compositor is rightDerivedLowerShriekCompIso.

lean.statement: theorem properRouteCompIso_refl {W X S : Scheme.{u}} (p : W ⟶ X) (f : X ⟶ S) [IsProper p] [IsProper f] : properRouteCompIso A p f (p ≫ f) rfl = rightDerivedLowerShriekCompIso A p f
